resources.string: Waiting for phone…\nIn Emula on your paired phone, choose Send all cards to watch. Keep both apps open. Bluetooth only.
Existing cards are kept. Matching UIDs are skipped. Receiving cards does not start or change emulation.
Allow Nearby devices access to receive cards over Bluetooth.
Turn on Bluetooth, then try again.
Could not complete the transfer. Check Bluetooth and try again from the phone. Repeating a transfer skips matching UIDs.
Waiting timed out. Tap Try again, then send cards from the phone.
Receiving stopped. Tap Try again to receive cards.
Remove this card from the watch? Active emulation will stop first.
%1$s, UID %2$s. Emulation enabled. Tap to stop.
Grant the one-time ADB permission, then try again.
Turn on NFC in watch settings, then try again.
No usable NFC emulation API on this firmware.
Send a report to help investigate.
Enable emulation with a one-time ADB permission.
Open Developer options in watch settings.
Tap a card to emulate or stop. Hold to edit. Swipe left to delete.
Experimental on Android 15+ watches. Without the OEM UID API, Emula can try raw NFC with your approval. Compatibility depends on firmware and reader. Reader-confirmed: SM-L355F, 4-byte UID via OEM.

Try another emulation method on this firmware? Compatibility is unverified. Emula saves the original NFC settings and restores them when you stop. If restoration fails, use Restore NFC before using other NFC apps. Approval resets after a firmware update.
Grant the one-time ADB permission to enable emulation.
Enable wireless debugging in watch Developer options. Pair an ADB client on your phone or computer, then run this command. Emula detects the permission automatically.
On your paired phone, open Emula → menu → Get watch diagnostics. Keep both apps open. Bluetooth only.
The report may contain card UIDs. Review it on the phone before sharing.
Allow Nearby devices access to send the report over Bluetooth.
Transfer stopped. Tap Try again, then receive on the phone.
Waiting timed out. Tap Try again, then receive on the phone.
Could not deliver the report. Check Bluetooth and try again on both devices. Both apps need diagnostics transfer support.
Report saved on the phone. You can review, copy or share it there.
The report is too large to transfer. Restart Emula and reproduce the error once.
Turn on NFC in watch settings
Neither OEM UID emulation nor the experimental raw path is available on this firmware
NFC-A profile verified by configuration readback
